title: Nahato's 'The One. Later On...' Light Novels Get TV Anime in 2027
content:
A website opened on Sunday to announce the television anime adaptation of Nahato 's Sono Mono. Nochi ni... ( The One. Later On... ) light novel series which will premiere in 2027. The website also presented a teaser visual and the anime's main cast and staff members.

The anime will star:

Kent Itō as Wazu

Yui Ogura as Mear

Kōichi Ōhata ( Burst Angel , Ikki Tousen: Dragon Destiny director) is the anime's chief director, and Seung Deok Kim ( Black Clover , Lucifer and the Biscuit Hammer , Ace of Diamond Act II episode director) is directing the anime at Jumondo . Ōhata is also overseeing the series scripts along with Hisashi Morimiya ( Queen's Blade: Rebellion , The Warrior Princess and the Barbaric King ), and designing the characters with Choi Yeon-soo (name romanization not confirmed). Pony Canyon is in charge of music production. Kent Itō will also perform the anime's opening theme song.

Titan Manga is releasing Shinichirō Nariie 's manga adaptation of the novel under the title The One. Later On... , and describes the story:

Wazu's life was forever changed when he was rejected by the hero's party and forced to leave his hometown. Once a weak, ordinary boy, he spent two years training alone in the mountains to prove his worth. Now, stronger and determined, Wazu returns to a world that has moved on — only to find his childhood friend, Aria, engaged to the hero who once mocked him. Heartbroken, Wazu embarks on a new journey, facing misunderstandings, new relationships, and the challenge of finding his place in a world that has changed.

Nahato launched the story on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō website in September 2015, and ended it in August 2016. Earth Star Entertainment released the novel series with illustrations by Kazutomo Miya in 12 main volumes and one spinoff volume in print. The manga adaptation launched in August 2018, and Earth Star Entertainment published the sixth volume in November 2022.
author: ANN

title: Singer, Voice Actress Kiyono Yasuno Announces Marriage
content:
Voice actress Kiyono Yasuno announced her marriage on her official website on Sunday.

In her written message, Yasuno expressed her gratitude to everyone who had supported her throughout her career as a voice actress and singer. She also stated that she would continue to approach her works and roles with sincerity and strive to grow further as a performer.

"Although I still have much to learn, I hope to continue growing as an individual as well, taking things one step at a time each day. I would be grateful if you would continue to watch over me warmly," she wrote.

Yasuno was born in Kyoto Prefecture on July 9, 1989. She moved to Miyagi Prefecture shortly after her birth. She grew up in Wakuya, from the age of three to 11 before moving to Tokyo during her sixth year of elementary school. At the age of nine, she became interested in voice acting after watching a special program about Kaitou Saint Tail , which featured behind the scenes footage of anime voice recording sessions.

At the age of 15, Yasuno entered the Voice Actor Talent Course at Avex Artist Academy as a scholarship student. She made her leading role debut in 2011 as Kizuna Todoroki in the theatrical anime Kizuna Ichigeki .

Yasuno is best known for her roles as Katou Megumi in Saenai Heroine no Sodatekata , Charmy Pappitson in Black Clover , Nejire Hadou in Boku no Hero Academia 3rd Season , Renner in Overlord II , Kaname Buccaneer in Macross Δ , and Botan Kumegawa in Anne Happy♪ .

Yasuno also has been active as a singer in music units like Walküre and The iDOLM@STER Cinderella Girls. She made her solo singing debut in July 2017 with the mini-album Namida. under flying DOG . In November 2021, she formed music duo Poka Poka Ion with fellow voice actress Nao Touyama , which performed the opening theme for the Slow Loop television anime.

In March 2021, Yasuno received the Singing Award at the 15th Seiyuu Awards as a member of Walküre.

Official profile site: https://avex-pictures.co.jp/lineup/13332/ Official instagram: @ kiyonon_at_home Official YouTube: @ yasunokiyono.official

title: Light Novel 'Sono Mono. Nochi ni…' Gets TV Anime in 2027
content:
An official website opened for a television anime adaptation of NAHAaTO 's Sono Mono. Nochi ni... ( That Person. Later on... ) light novel on Sunday, revealing the main cast, staff, opening theme song artist, and a teaser visual (pictured). The anime will premiere in 2027.

Voice actors Kent Itou ( Isekai no Sata wa Shachiku Shidai ) and Yui Ogura ( Goblin Slayer ) are starring in the anime as Wazu and Mear, respectively.

Staff Chief Director: Kouichi Oohata ( 9: Ruler's Crown director) Director: Seung-deok Kim ( Kizoku Tensei assistant director) Series Composition: Kouichi Oohata , Hisashi Morimiya ( Himekishi wa Barbaroi no Yome ) Character Design: Kouichi Oohata , Yeon-su Choi Music Production: Pony Canyon Studio: Jumondou

Voice actor Kent Itou will perform the anime's opening theme song.

NAHAaTO originally penned the adventure fantasy novel on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website from September 2015 to August 2016. Earth Star Entertainment began publishing the light novel under its Earth Star Novel imprint in August 2016, featuring illustrations by Kazutomo Miya . The 12th and final volume was released in April 2019.

Urasuke Ayano drew the first manga adaptation in Comic Earth☆Star from March to August 2017, before getting discontinued. Earth Star Entertainment published the first volume in October 2017.

A second manga adaptation by Shinichirou Nariie ( Food Court de, Mata Ashita. ) began serialization in the same magazine in August 2018. Earth Star Entertainment published the sixth volume in November 2022.

Titan Comics licensed the second manga adaptation in English. The second volume was released on 27 October, with the third volume scheduled for a January 2027 release.

title: 'Tensei Kizoku, Kantei Skill de Nariagaru 3rd Season' Reveals Additional Cast, Fourth Promo for "Assassin" Arc
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Miraijin A 's Tensei Kizoku, Kantei Skill de Nariagaru: Jakushou Ryouchi wo Uketsuida node, Yuushuu na Jinzai wo Fuyashiteitara, Saikyou Ryouchi ni Natteta ( As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I'll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World ) light novel revealed additional cast, and the fourth promotional video for the third season on Sunday. The new arc is scheduled to premiere on November 22 at 11:30 p.m. on CBC and TBS' 28-station "Agaru Anime" programming block.

Cast Enan Lugez: Anna Nagase ( Enen no Shouboutai ) Virge Sammando: Kousuke Toriumi ( Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu ) Keefe Venge: Ayumu Murase ( Reincarnation no Kaben )

Takao Kato ( Pandora Hearts ) is directing the anime at GeyeG Pictures , with Hiroaki Matsushima ( Arifureta Shokugyou de Sekai Saikyou 2nd Season episode director) serving as assistant director. Daisuke Oohigashi ( Fate/Strange Fake ) is handling the series composition. Yuuko Yahiro ( Kaguya-sama wa Kokurasetai: Tensai-tachi no Renai Zunousen ) is designing the characters. Kujira Yumemi ( Lv2 kara Cheat datta Motoyuusha Kouho no Mattari Isekai Life ) is composing the music.

Produced by studio MOTHER , the first season aired in 12-episode in Spring 2024, followed by the second season in Fall 2024. Crunchyroll streamed the anime with subtitles in multiple languages and an English dub.

Miraijin A began penning the novel on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website in October 2019. Kodansha published the first volume with illustrations by JIMMY under its K Ranobe Books imprint in July 2020. The ninth volume went on sale on June 2, with the tenth volume scheduled for a December 2 release.

Natsumi Inoue began drawing a manga adaptation on the Magazine pocket app in June 2020. Kodansha published the 21th volume on June 9.

Kodansha USA licensed both the manga and light novel in English in November 2021 and March 2022, respectively. The 14th manga volume went on sale on April 21. The seventh light novel volume was published in November 2025.

PV 4

title: 4-Piece Band Subway Daydream Disbands
content:
Four-piece rock band Subway Daydream has announced its disbandment on Sunday. The band had been on hiatus since January, due to a member's poor health. The band had been discussing about resuming their musical activities, but decided to disband due to the members' differences in the direction of their future activities. The band expressed their gratitude to their fans, and asked to support the members in their future individual activities.

Subway Daydream consisted of vocalist Tamami, guitar and vocalist Masao Fujishima, guitarist Hiroshi Fujishima, and drummer Kana. The band formed in Osaka in 2020.

The band released their first album titled RIDE in January 2023, and their second album 100% in March 2025. The band performed the opening theme song "Stand By Me" for the "Ippon" Again! anime series in 2023.

title: Shōzen TV Anime Unveils New Trailer, Key Visual, Cast
content:
The staff for Shōzen , the television anime adaptation of Jiang Jia Meizi 's Chinese manhua Shang Shan , revealed a new trailer, key visual, and another cast member on Sunday.

Kana Hanazawa plays Ko Kuka, Dōzen's childhood friend who shares a special bond with him.

The series will debut on the B8station programming block on Fuji TV and other venues in April 2027.

The story follows a Taoist priest Dōzen who encounters a young girl raised by supernatural creatures during his travels. He names the girl Shōzen, adopting her as his disciple, as he teaches her about human emotion and love.

The anime will star:

• Rina Kawaguchi as Shōzen

• Hiroshi Kamiya as Dōzen

• Daisuke Sakuma (Snow Man) as Ryojin

• Aoi Yūki as Kensei

• Ayumu Murase as Chiro

Itsurō Kawasaki ( True Cooking Master Boy , Lady Jewelpet ) is directing the series at Dangan Pictures and Cannon Code , and is also writing the scripts. Eri Osada ( Ensemble Stars! , The World's Finest Assassin ) is designing the characters and serving as chief animation director. Takurō Iga ( Magical Girl Raising Project , Oshi no Ko ) is composing the music.

Additional staff members include:

• Assistant Director: Tomohiro Matsukawa

• Monster Design/Prop Design: Kenji Yamazaki, Yūichi Karasawa

• Sub-Character Design: Keiko Kōno, Shihoko Shirai

• Action Director: Yoshihiro Kanno

• Effects Supervisor: Kazunori Ozawa

• Logo Design: Seita Takahashi

• Art Director: Itsuki Ōishi

• Color Key Artist: Takashi Nagata

• Visual Design: Yūsaku Ishimi

• Compositing Director of Photography: Iori Yokoi

• Editing: Daisuke Hiraki

• Sound Director: Itsurō Kawasaki

• Sound Effects: Sachiko Nishi

• Sound Production: Aoni Production

Jiang publishes the ongoing series on bilibili Manga.

title: 'Hidan no Aria Corto' Reveals Main Staff, New Cast, April 2027 Premiere
content:
The MF Bunko J Autumn School Festival 2026 event revealed the main staff, new cast, and a key visual (pictured) for Hiden no Aria Corto ( Aria the Scarlet Ammo Corto ) on Sunday. The short anime adapting Chuugaku Akamatsu 's action comedy light novel will stream on various platforms beginning in April 2027.

Cast Kinji Tooyama: Junji Majima ( Choujin Koukousei-tachi wa Isekai demo Yoyuu de Ikinuku you desu! ) Aria Holmes Kanzaki: Rie Kugimiya ( Gintama ) Shirayuki Hotogi: Mikako Takahashi ( D-Frag! ) Riko Mine: Mariya Ise ( Made in Abyss ) Reki: Kaori Ishihara ( Majutsushi Kunon wa Mieteiru ) Jeanne d'Arc: Ayako Kawasumi ( Yuusha no Kuzu ) Lisa Ave du Ankh: Emiri Iwai ( Summer Pockets ) NEW Minuet Holmes: Miyari Nemoto ( Ruri no Houseki ) NEW Nemo Lincoln: Anzu Haruno ( Blend S ) NEW

Note: The new cast members are denoted with the legend NEW .

Staff Director: Yoshifumi Sasahara ( Akudama Drive assistant director) Series Composition, Script: Chuugaku Akamatsu, Kenji Saitou ( Trinity Seven original creator) Studio: Bellnox Films

Akamatsu began penning the action comedy light novel under the MF Bunko J imprint in August 2008, featuring illustrations by Kobuichi ( Kore wa Zombie desu ka? ). Kadokawa published the 45th volume on June 25, with the 46th volume scheduled to be released on December 25. Hidan no Aria has over 9 million copies of its volumes in circulation.

• J.C.Staff adapted the light novel into a 12-episode television anime in Spring 2011, covering the first three volumes. The seventh Blu-ray and DVD volume included a special episode in December 2011.

Doga Kobo produced the 12-episode Hidan no Aria AA ( Aria the Scarlet Ammo AA ) television anime adapting Akamatsu and Shogako Tachibana 's spin-off manga in Fall 2015.

title: New Aria the Scarlet Ammo Short Anime Unveils Title, New & Returning Cast, April 2027 Debut
content:
Kadokawa revealed on Sunday the key visual, returning and new cast members, main staff, and April 2027 streaming debut for Hidan no Aria Corto ( Aria the Scarlet Ammo Corto ), the new short anime commemorating the 15th anniversary of the Aria the Scarlet Ammo anime series.

Returning anime cast members are (image above from left to right):

• Rie Kugimiya as Aria H. Kanzaki

• Junji Majima as Kinji Tōyama

• Mikako Takahashi as Shirayuki Hotogi

• Mariya Ise as Riko Mine

• Kaori Ishihara as Reki

• Ayako Kawasumi as Jeanne d'Arc (not included in above visual)

The new cast and characters that will appear in the short anime are (image above from left to right):

• Emiri Iwai as Lisa Ave du Ank

• Miyari Nemoto as Minuet Holmes

• Anzu Haruno as Nemo Rinkarun

Yoshifumi Sasahara (episode director for That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime , My Hero Academia , Classroom of the Elite ) is directing the anime at BELLNOX FILMS . Manga storywriter Kenji Saitō ( Trinity Seven - The Seven Magicians , Goodbye! I'm Being Reincarnated! , Saint Seiya: Dark Wing ) and Aria the Scarlet Ammo original novel author Chūgaku Akamatsu are in charge of series scripts.

The new anime is set in Gakuen-shima (Academy Island), where Aria and Kinji are confronted with the crisis of drones and robots going on a rampage, upon their return to Japan from solving cases around the world.

Aria the Scarlet Ammo Double A ( Hidan no Aria AA ), the novels' spinoff manga by Shogako Tachibana , also inspired a 12-episode television anime adaptation that premiered in October 2015. Funimation streamed the anime, and also released the anime on Blu-ray Disc and DVD in April 2017 with an English dub .

Kadokawa will publish the original novels' 46th volume on December 25. Yoshino Koyoka has been drawing a manga adaptation of the novels in Kadokawa 's Monthly Comic Alive magazine since 2009, and Kadokawa published the 26th compiled book volume in February 2025. Digital Manga Inc. previously released three volumes of the manga digitally. The series has over 9 million copies in circulation.

The Aria the Scarlet Ammo Double A spinoff manga launched in Square Enix 's Young Gangan magazine in 2010, and the series ended in 2018.
author: ANN

title: Mission: Yozakura Family Season 2 Anime's 2nd Part Casts Shinichirō Miki
content:
The staff for the anime of Hitsuji Gondaira 's Mission: Yozakura Family ( Yozakura-san Chi no Daisakusen ) manga announced on Sunday Shinichirō Miki will join the cast of the second part of the second season in episode 47, which airs on November 29.

Miki plays Asa, a man who holds the key to solving the mysteries of the story.

The second part of the second season premiered on MBS , TBS , and 26 other channels on October 11 at 5:00 p.m. (4:00 a.m. EDT).

Disney describes the anime's story:

High school student Taiyou Asano has been socially inept ever since his family died in a car crash. The only person he can properly interact with is his childhood friend, Mutsumi Yozakura—the head of the world's strongest family of spies. Mutsumi's eldest brother, Kyouichirou Yozakura, has been overprotective of her ever since he once rendered her severely injured. His love for Mutsumi is lethal, and Taiyou is his next target. To survive, Taiyou must marry Mutsumi and become a member of the Yozakura family. Thrown headfirst into chaos, Taiyou begins his journey to become a powerful spy in order to protect his wife and uncover the dark secrets of his past and the Yozakura family.

For the current season, Mirai Minato is now the chief director of the anime at SILVER LINK , and is again overseeing the series scripts. Takahiro Nakatsugawa , who worked as a storyboard artist and episode director on the first season, is directing the anime. Other returning staff includes character designer Mizuki Takahashi , composer Kōji Fujimoto , and sound director Tōru Kanegae .

The second season premiered on April 12 on MBS , TBS , and 26 other affiliated channels during the "Nichigo" programming block, which runs on Sundays at 5:00 p.m. JST (4:00 a.m. EDT). Hulu streams the new season. The second season's first part ended with the anime's overall 39th episode on June 28.

The first season premiered in Japan in April 2024 on MBS , TBS , and 26 of their affiliate channels. Disney streams the anime through the Hulu service with an English dub in the United States. The series also streams on Prime Video and Netflix in Japan.

Gondaira ( Demon Prince Poro's Diaries ) launched the manga in Shueisha 's Weekly Shonen Jump magazine in August 2019. The manga ended its serialization in January 2025. Shueisha published the 29th and final compiled book volume in March 2025.

Viz Media simultaneously published the manga in English digitally since its debut in Japan. Viz Media then began publishing volumes digitally in December 2020, and began releasing the series physically starting with the first volume in October 2022. Shueisha 's MANGA Plus service also released the manga digitally in English.

The franchise also includes several novels.
author: ANN

title: The Detective Is Already Dead Season 2 Reveals New Trailer, Visual
content:
The Detective Is Already Dead Season 2 revealed a new trailer and visual. The announcements were made at the MF Bunko J Autumn School Festival 2026 event. Season 2 is currently airing and is available to watch on Crunchyroll and Muse Asia.

Studio ENGI returns to animate the sequel with Manabu Kurihara as director. Other returning staff include Deko Akao as scriptwriter and Yosuke Ito as the character designer. The main cast will also reprise their roles:

• Saki Miyashita as Siesta

• Ayana Taketatsu as Nagisa Natsunagi

• Kanon Tako as Yui Saikawa

• Saho Shirasu as Charlotte Arisaka Anderson

• Arata Nagai as Kimihiko Kimizuka

The Detective is Already Dead is a Japanese light novel series written by Nigozyu and illustrated by Umibozu. Media Factory started publishing the series in November 2019. The series also has 2 manga adaptation: one by Mugiko (2020-2023) and one by Poni (2021-2022).

Yen Press licensed The Detective is Already Dead light novel series in English. Crunchyroll streams the anime, describing the story: After thwarting a hijacking with beautiful, silver-haired detective Siesta, Kimihiko leads a life of globe-trotting and crime-solving—until Siesta dies. A year later, a new case will open old wounds as it threads murder, conspiracy, and his dead partner! Source: The Detective is Already Dead Official X ©Nigozyu, Umibozu / KADOKAWA / Tanmoshi Production Committee
